the_anomaly.summary: When every major automaker abandoned the Wankel rotary engine, Mazda alone persisted and succeeded
the_anomaly.mazda_perseverance: Mazda is the only company to successfully mass-produce rotary engines for over 50 years

the_47_ronin.description: Elite team of 47 engineers dedicated exclusively to solving rotary problems
the_47_ronin.name_origin: Named after legendary 47 samurai who avenged their master against impossible odds
the_47_ronin.primary_challenge: Chatter marks - irregular wear patterns on rotor housings
the_47_ronin.breakthrough: Carbon-aluminum composite apex seals on chrome-molybdenum plated housings
the_47_ronin.legacy: Established rotary engineering expertise that competitors could never match

1961.event: Mazda signs licensing agreement with NSU for Wankel technology

1963.event: Formation of the '47 Ronin' engineering team
1963.significance: Dedicated resources to solve rotary challenges

1971.significance: Beginning of RX-3's dominant racing career
1971.racing_wins: Over 100 touring car victories in Japan

1973.significance: The defining rotary - still in production concepts today

1974.event: OPEC oil crisis threatens rotary program
1974.significance: Mazda nearly abandons rotary due to fuel economy concerns
1974.outcome: President Matsuda commits to continue development

1978.significance: Establishes rotary sports car icon status

1991.significance: Only rotary victory at Le Mans - regulations changed to ban rotary afterward
1991.margin: Two laps ahead of second place

1992.significance: Sequential twin-turbo - pinnacle of rotary performance

2002.significance: End of pure rotary sports car era (temporarily)

2012.significance: Last pure rotary production car (to date)

2015.significance: Despite no production car, rotary R&D never stopped

2021.event: 8C rotary range extender in MX-30 R-EV

2023.significance: Rotary enters new era as EV range extender

production_statistics.other_rotary_models: R100, RX-2, RX-3, RX-4, RX-5, Luce, Roadpacer

reasons.explanation: The 47 Ronin gave rotary development singular focus
Apex seal and housing coating innovations others couldn't match
Leadership refused to abandon rotary despite pressure
Rotary's strengths matched sports car requirements perfectly
Rotary became Mazda's differentiator in crowded market
Competitors treated rotary as side project
Early rotaries couldn't meet tightening standards
1973 oil embargo hit during critical development phase
Apex seal durability couldn't be solved quickly
When problems arose, easier to retreat to pistons

legacy_quotes.kenichi_yamamoto: The rotary engine is simple in structure but complex in dynamics. We understood that mastering it would give us something no competitor could easily replicate.
legacy_quotes.takahiro_saiki: When everyone told us the rotary was dead, we heard opportunity.
legacy_quotes.motorsport_journalist: The 787B didn't just win Le Mans. It proved that unconventional thinking, pursued with absolute commitment, can triumph over established wisdom.
